purpose: Using only the existing 435126 strict edges, convert the question 'which existing structure could in principle break the dominant bilaterally symmetric front/hind mode' into exactly checkable numbers, and state plainly where required coupling is absent (missing-data finding), without adding edges.

intrinsic_report.finding: no contralateral alternation; PC1 49.5% front/hind mode; LF-RH r=.036, RF-LH r=.082

adaptation_screen_report.finding: scaling motor-neuron adaptation alone does not create alternation

invariants.I-E: edge set equals the 435126 strict edges loaded by the frozen module; no additions, deletions, sign flips or transmitter reclassification
invariants.I-W: weights equal the frozen _We/_Wi values; read-only this round
invariants.I-Z: zero bytes written to frozen files; tracked repo files (AGENTS.md, GOAL_ROADMAP.zh-CN.md, GOAL_TRACKER.zh-CN.md) not modified this round

frozen_weight_contract.incoming_raw: sum of synapse_counts over both receptor types for the same post index
frozen_weight_contract.matrices: _We = acetylcholine edges, _Wi = gaba+glutamate edges, csr shape (20000,20000) indexed [post, pre]
frozen_weight_contract.convention: every neuron with incoming edges has total incoming conductance exactly 0.02 uS (the .02 uS convention)

pre_registration_disclosures.statement: Only the following structural sanity checks were executed before this preregistration was written. No pool size, block count, symmetry index or tripod-coupling quantity was computed before this file existed.
checks_run: LOCAL_MODULE_CANDIDATE.npz key/shape/dtype inventory and source_verified_nt value counts
strict eligible subset nt in {acetylcholine,gaba,glutamate} = 435126 edges; acetylcholine 207166, gaba+glutamate 227960
no duplicate ordered (pre_local,post_local) pair in the strict subset (435126 unique ordered pairs), no self loops (count 0), synapse_counts are positive integers 3..805
frozen module instantiates: _We.nnz=207166, _Wi.nnz=227960, sum 435126; sum(_We)=126.82030644091996 uS, sum(_Wi)=254.01969355908005 uS; 19042 neurons have nonzero incoming and each totals 0.02 uS
LOCAL_MOTOR_READOUT_PORTS.csv readout_eligible_single_leg=='True' rows = 323 with single lowercase leg labels: lf 43, lh 59, lm 60, rf 42, rh 59, rm 60

definitions.M: the 323 mn_local motor readout cells; leg(q) taken directly from the CSV, never inferred from the graph
definitions.direct_leg_reach_D: D(p) = { leg(q) : exists edge (pre=p, post=q) in E with q in M }
definitions.two_hop_leg_reach_H: H(p) = { leg(q) : exists x not in M with edges (p->x) and (x->q), q in M }; length exactly 2, non-MN intermediate

buckets.coverage: mutually exclusive and exhaustive over all 20000 neurons; every neuron in exactly one bucket
buckets.rationale_pool_mn: the 323 leg labels come from measured nerve matching in the readout CSV, not from edges; merging them into a premotor leg pool would confuse readout targets with premotor sources

definitions.supplementary_partition: same decision order with D(p) replaced by D(p) union H(p); used only to quantify how many direct-only nonmotor cells reach a MN within two hops
definitions.block: block_X(b_src -> b_dst) = { X[post, pre] : pre in b_src, post in b_dst }
aggregate_views: within-pool diagonal blocks for the 6 leg pools
left->right and right->left aggregates (source side x target side)

6x6 directed leg-pair matrix C[leg_src][leg_dst] plus all 15 unordered leg pairs grouped as ipsilateral (6), contralateral same-row (3), contralateral cross-row (6), with tripod partners LF-RH and RF-LH listed separately
premotor drive matrix: 9 source buckets x 6 target MN legs, edges/synapses/conductance per receptor type

symmetry_indices.cell_count_asymmetry: (a-b)/(a+b) per mirrored bucket pair, with integer a, b and |a-b|
symmetry_indices.block_conductance_asymmetry: for G[b_src][b_dst] define G'[b_src][b_dst] = G[mir(b_dst)][mir(b_src)]; asym_index = sum|G-G'| / sum(G+G'), with raw uS numerator and denominator
symmetry_indices.leg_pair_asymmetry: for each unordered leg pair, |G({A->B,B->A}) - G(mirrored pair asymmetric total)| in uS and relative
symmetry_indices.row_sum_decomposition: per target bucket, exact 9-component decomposition of incoming conductance by source bucket; components must sum bit-exactly to 0.02 * number of target-bucket neurons with nonzero incoming

decision_rules_fixed_before_analysis.asymmetry_label: |asym| < 0.05 -> within 5 percent band (no asymmetry detected); |asym| >= 0.05 -> asymmetry detected. Raw integers and uS values are always reported regardless of the label.
decision_rules_fixed_before_analysis.coupling_decision: exact path counts, not conductance thresholds: at path length <= 2, count >= 1 means structural coupling exists; count == 0 means no coupling at that length (missing-data finding)
decision_rules_fixed_before_analysis.path_length_not_analyzed: >= 3 (on a 20k cell graph almost everything is reachable at longer length; enumeration carries no structural information) - state explicitly as not analyzed
decision_rules_fixed_before_analysis.statistics: descriptive counts and sums only; no hypothesis tests, no p values, no multiple-comparison correction, no post-hoc added analyses
decision_rules_fixed_before_analysis.deviation_policy: any discovered definition gap must be appended to DEVIATIONS.md and the full analysis re-run; no silent criterion changes

levels.L0_direct_premotor_interconnect: edges pool_A -> pool_B and pool_B -> pool_A, per receptor and per conductance. Note: by the bucket definition a pool_A cell's direct MN targets are all in A, so it cannot have a direct edge onto a B MN; this is a definitional corollary and must be stated explicitly, not reported as missing data.
levels.L1_shared_bridge: cells that directly target both A and B MNs (D(p) = {A,B} or D(p) superset {A,B}); their incoming/outgoing edge counts and conductance
levels.L2_two_hop: #paths_2(A->B) and #paths_2(B->A) with non-MN intermediate, distinct intermediate cell counts, and the share of those paths passing through a pool_shared intermediate
levels.L3_verdict: if L0, L1 and L2 are all zero -> the strict subgraph contains no structure usable to break that mode (missing-data finding). If only L2 is nonzero -> two-hop only, no direct or single-bridge coupling, with the path count reported.

parameterization_proposal_constraints.applies_to: PROPOSED_SCALING_PARAMS.json (design document only; nothing simulated this round)
parameterization_proposal_constraints.rule: w'[e] = s[class(e)] * w[e] with s > 0; no new edges, no deletions, no transmitter reclassification, no sign flips
parameterization_proposal_constraints.class_partition: mutually exclusive and exhaustive over all 435126 edges; JSON must report per-class edge counts and frozen conductance totals so sum(class edges) == 435126 is independently checkable

conductance_convention_variants.V1_row_renormalized: after applying w', renormalize each target neuron's incoming edges to exactly 0.02 uS, so per-neuron incoming total stays bit-exactly at the frozen convention
conductance_convention_variants.V2_bounded_unrenormalized: no renormalization, but each target neuron's incoming total must lie in [0.5, 2.0] * 0.02 uS; out-of-range totals are projected back to the boundary
conductance_convention_variants.selection: the next round must preregister exactly one of these two

parameterization_proposal_constraints.no_validity_claim: the proposal is not validated by any number in this round; any s != 1 is an untested hypothesis. Do not later report 'can be rescaled' as 'can produce gait'.
parameterization_proposal_constraints.next_round_requirements: new timestamped directory, new preregistration, open-loop screen before any physics, no external oscillator, no acceptance-criteria changes

outputs: MIRROR_MANIFEST.json (desktop directory only, excluded from its own mirrored set)
explicitly_not_done: no added, removed or sign-flipped edges
no bytes written to frozen files; no tracked repo file modified
no claim that any bucket corresponds to a biological cell type
no fly anatomy claim, no function claim, no behaviour-feasibility claim
no tripod-gait achievability claim; the positive ceiling is 'a coupling structure exists or does not exist in the strict subgraph, with exact size'
no change to any acceptance criterion; intrinsic/ and adaptation-screen/ historical conclusions untouched
